newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 28.

text.p: Following were the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Sri Lanka's exports to the United kingdom rose by 13 percent in 1996 led by the garment industry.
Government issues special national identity cards to residents of the northern Jaffna area. Military recaptured the area from separatist rebels after almost a decade, in 1996.

Ruling People's Alliance coalition minister C.V. Gooneratne says action should be taken against cabinet colleague Srimani Athulathmudali who broke ranks and supported an independent candidate at recent local govenrment polls.
People in Weliveriya about 10 miles north of Colombo, demonstrate against removal of statue of St. Anthony by unknown persons on Thursday.
Police take steps to catch young man and woman who have been duping Sri Lankan businessmen with counterfeit currency notes.
South Indian fishermen recover body of solider who was aboard Sri Lanka Air Force Mi-24 helicopter which went missing over eatern Mullaitivu earlier this month.
